STOP, You’re Training Your Chest All Wrong. If your chest workout is built around doing the same traditional sets, resting two or three minutes, and then repeating them again, you may be wasting a lot of reps that aren’t doing nearly as much for muscle growth as you think.
In this video, I’m showing you a different way to train your chest using a hypertrophy technique called effective reps. The goal is simple: spend less time doing the easier reps that only get you to fatigue, and more time doing the hard, high-effort reps that are most responsible for stimulating new muscle growth.
